bb-riverboats.mobility.1: Boarding ramps and main decks are wheelchair accessible. The Belle of Cincinnati features an elevator providing access to the first three decks, while the fourth deck is stair-access only.
bb-riverboats.mobility.2: The main deck of The River Queen is also handicapped accessible.
bb-riverboats.chronic.1: Smoking is permitted on designated outdoor decks only. Smoking is not allowed inside any interior cabin areas aboard the boats.
bb-riverboats.mobility.3: Complimentary parking is available in front of the dock on Riverboat Row on a first-come, first-served basis.
bb-riverboats.cognitive.1: Most cruises offer a full hour for boarding, while select cruise experiences may have shorter 30-minute boarding windows.
Unfortunately, cruises are unable to wait for late arrivals.
BB Riverboats is a cashless operation. Credit and debit cards are the only forms of payment accepted aboard our cruises and at our facilities.
bb-riverboats.cognitive.2: BB Riverboats cruises operate rain or shine. In the event of severe weather or unsafe river conditions, the captain will determine whether cruising is possible.
bb-riverboats.chronic.2: Featuring elegant Victorian-inspired details, climate-controlled decks, and expansive open-air viewing areas, the Belle combines classic riverboat atmosphere with modern comfort.
Featuring spacious climate-controlled dining decks, full-service bars, a dance floor, and open-air viewing areas, the River Queen offers a relaxed and memorable atmosphere
bb-riverboats.chronic.3: Our culinary team proudly offers gluten-free, vegetarian, and vegan options
Simply let us know about any dietary needs when making your reservation
